listings.caption: Sets layer sizes and a three-dimensional sample input, initializes the network without shortcut connections, and calls the gradient-printing helper on that model.
listings.code:
layer_sizes = [3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 1]  

sample_input = torch.tensor([[1., 0., -1.]])

torch.manual_seed(123)
model_without_shortcut = ExampleDeepNeuralNetwork(
    layer_sizes, use_shortcut=False
)
print_gradients(model_without_shortcut, sample_input)
listings.reason: The snippet sets the specified layer sizes (including five hidden 3→3 layers and a final 3→1), defines the 3D sample input [1, 0, -1], fixes the seed, instantiates the ExampleDeepNeuralNetwork with use_shortcut=False (i.e., without shortcut connections), and calls the gradient-printing helper on that model. This aligns with the section’s described setup and the caption accurately describes what the code does.
